description: This file defines the TaskProvider class, a state management class for handling task data in a Flutter application. It manages a list of tasks, filtering, and listening to real-time updates from a TaskRepository. The class provides methods for adding, updating, deleting, and filtering tasks, and extends ChangeNotifier to notify UI components of data changes.

classes.name: TaskProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier managing task data, filtering, and synchronization with a repository. It provides methods to manipulate tasks and notifies listeners on data changes.

methods.name: TaskProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the task provider with a repository and user ID getter, and starting the listening process.

methods.name: _listen
methods.description: Sets up a stream subscription to listen for all task updates for the current user.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query string for filtering tasks.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the filter status (e.g., completed, pending) for tasks.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task through the repository.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task through the repository.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task by ID through the repository.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cancels the stream subscription and performs cleanup.
